# zcordis — LLM context index

zcordis (Cordis Native) is a Zig 0.17 reimplementation of the Cordis plugin
meta-framework, with a self-written WASM MVP interpreter. This file indexes the
documentation for AI agents and LLM-based tooling.

## Project overview

- README.md — what/why/status, build/test/fuzz commands, docs index, sandbox invariants
- AGENTS.md — operational cheat-sheet for coding agents (commands, sandbox rules, conventions)

## Developer documentation (English)

- docs/getting-started.md — Context, Scope, services, typed + dynamic events, scope tree
- docs/plugins.md — native manifest plugins, C-ABI plugins, WASM plugins, loader teardown
- docs/effects.md — Effect / Scheduler / Task, scope-bound cancellation, I/O context
- docs/harness-example.md — worked DeepSeek-Harness-style agent-runtime example
- docs/wasm-interpreter.md — authoritative WASM interpreter reference (opcodes, f64, bulk-memory, Builder API)

## Source map (for grounding code questions)

- src/cordis.zig — public re-exports
- src/core/ — context.zig, scope.zig, error.zig
- src/service/ — service.zig, registry.zig
- src/event/ — event.zig, bus.zig, dispatcher.zig, listener.zig
- src/effect/ — effect.zig, scheduler.zig, task.zig, cancellation.zig
- src/loader/ — loader.zig, manifest.zig, module.zig, wasm_demo.zig
- src/abi/ — c.zig (C ABI + generated header), wasm.zig (interpreter)
- src/io/ — io.zig

## Examples

- examples/basic.zig — minimal composition
- examples/loader.zig + examples/plugins/greet_plugin.zig — C-ABI dynamic plugin
- examples/wasm_loader.zig — WASM plugin in the interpreter

## Guidelines

- Sandbox invariant: malformed input must return `error`, never crash the host.
- Use `Builder` (src/abi/wasm.zig) for WASM test binaries; never hand-roll bytecode.
- Loader teardown order: `defer loader.deinit(); defer ctx.deinit();` (loader after ctx).
- Run `zig fmt` on touched files; keep `zig build test` and (for interpreter work) `zig build fuzz-wasm -- 100000` green.
